data_description.pairing_instructions_generic:
1. Put the bed into Bluetooth pairing mode as its manual describes.
2. Choose **Pair now**, then select **Submit**.
data_description.pairing_instructions_okin:
1. Put the OKIN base into Bluetooth pairing mode by power-cycling the control box: unplug it for ~30 seconds, then plug it back in. The status light blinks blue, then turns green after ~20 seconds. (Some models instead use the under-bed lamp/light button - hold it until the light blinks blue.) There is no separate Bluetooth pairing button; any Pair/Learn button on the box only syncs the RF remote.
2. While the light is active, choose **Pair now** and select **Submit**.
data_description.pairing_instructions_sleep_number:
1. Put your bed in pairing mode (hold the side pairing button until the blue light blinks)
2. Choose **Pair now**, then select **Submit**.
data_description.pairing_instructions_leggett_gen2:
1. Unplug your bed's power cord and remove any batteries from the power supply.
2. Plug the bed back in. Wait for a small chime and a pulsing blue light under the bed.
3. While the light is pulsing, promptly choose **Pair now** and select **Submit**.

solace_family.title: Which app controls this bed?
solace_family.description: QMS and similar names are shared by several apps, so the name doesn't choose one. Choose the app you use on your phone. Current or detected setup: **{current}**.

solace_woosa.title: Woosa Sleep controls
solace_woosa.description: Woosa Sleep has its own Favourite memory, massage levels, lights and alarm, and no HomeKobo hip, lumbar or wave controls. Choose it only if you control the bed with the Woosa Sleep app.

leggett_family.title: Which app or remote controls this bed?
leggett_family.description: Each Leggett & Platt app has its own layout, and the bed's name doesn't tell them apart. Choose the app you use on your phone, or the remote if you don't use one. Current or detected setup: **{current}**.

sleepys_family.title: Which app or receiver controls this bed?
sleepys_family.description: The MFRM Sleepy's Elite app and the older control boxes send different commands, and the bed's name doesn't tell them apart. Choose the app you use on your phone, or, without the app, the label on the control box under the bed. Current or detected setup: **{current}**.

logicdata_family.title: Which LOGICDATA app controls this bed?
logicdata_family.description: The LOGICDATA apps share the bed's Bluetooth services, so the bed doesn't tell them apart. Choose the app you use on your phone or tablet. For the Sleep Smart Air Mattress app, choose the bed base or the air mattress pump: the pump is its own device, added as a separate entry. Current or detected setup: **{current}**.

customatic_family.title: Which Customatic app controls this bed?
customatic_family.description: The Customatic apps share the bed's Bluetooth name and service, so the name doesn't choose one. Choose the app you use on your phone, and for Z-Series the model chosen on the app's selection screen.

jordans_family.title: Which Jordan's app controls this bed?
jordans_family.description: Serenity and Tranquil share the bed's Bluetooth name and service, so the name doesn't choose one. Choose the app you use on your phone.

starcode_family.title: Which StarCode app controls this bed?
starcode_family.description: The StarCode apps work with the same beds, so the bed cannot tell which one you use. Choose the app you use on your phone; its own settings come next.

remacro_family.title: Which store app controls this bed?
remacro_family.description: Slumberland, The Brick and Jerome's run the same controller, and nothing the bed advertises names the app. Choose the app you use on your phone. Only the apps that list this bed's model are offered. Model the bed advertises: **{model}**.

reverie_family.title: Which Reverie receiver is in this bed?
reverie_family.description:
Reverie beds use one of two receivers. If you use the Reverie Nightstand app, choose the Nightstand receiver. If you use the older Reverie app, choose the older receiver. Home Assistant could not tell which one this bed has.

Not sure? Choose the receiver for the app you use, then check that the bed responds.

sleep_number_family.title: Which Sleep Number base is this?
sleep_number_family.description:
Sleep Number bases use one of two control boxes. Climate 360, FlexFit and FlexFit Smart bases are Fuzion bases. Older i8 and 360 FlexFit 2 bases use the older box. Home Assistant could not tell which one this bed has.

Not sure? Choose the box that matches your base's model, then check that the bed responds.

limoss_family.title: Which app controls this Limoss receiver?
limoss_family.description: Limoss Remote, FSM Relax and the older Limoss controls share the receiver's Bluetooth name and service, so the name doesn't choose one. Choose the app you use on your phone, or the older controls if you use none. Each has its own controls and memory format, and none is translated into another.

malouf_family.title: Which app or receiver controls this bed?
malouf_family.description: The Malouf Base and Lucid Base apps and the remotes send different commands, and the model name doesn't tell them apart. Choose the app you use on your phone, or the remote if you don't use an app. Current or detected setup: **{current}**.

jensen_family.title: Which app and bed is this?
jensen_family.description: The Jensen Adjustable Sleep app and the Svane Remote app send different commands, and both work with the same beds. Choose the app you use on your phone and the bed it controls. The suggestion follows the bed's Bluetooth name, as the apps do. A LinON Entry box is JMC400 hardware, not the LinOn bed.

richmat_family.title: Which Richmat app controls this bed?
richmat_family.description: Richmat apps share the bed's Bluetooth names and services, so the name doesn't choose one. Choose the app you use on your phone. Without one of these apps, choose the option for a Richmat remote.

select_app.title: Which app controls this bed?
select_app.description: Choose the app you use on your phone, or the remote if you don't use an app. Type to search apps, remotes and brands. If yours isn't listed, the last choice asks which brand is on the bed.

data.not_listed: My app isn't listed, or I don't know

select_family.title: Which brand is on the bed?
select_family.description: Look at the label on the motor box, the remote or the base, and search for its brand. Each row names the apps it covers. If none of these fit, choose **Not sure, or not listed**.

not_sure.title: Use the detected controls?
not_sure.description: Home Assistant recognized this device as **{detected}**. Use those controls, or look at it as an unsupported device and capture its data for a support request.

reconfigure_bed_type.title: Change the bed type or app
reconfigure_bed_type.description:
Currently: **{current}**.

Choose the app or remote that controls this bed. Nothing changes until you review and apply the change.

reconfigure_route.title: Choose the bed model or remote
reconfigure_route.description: **{bed_type}** has more than one bed model or remote. Automatic, where offered, is right for most beds.

discovery_settings.title: Find new beds automatically
discovery_settings.description: Home Assistant can suggest nearby beds as it sees them. Adding a bed from this list still works either way.

okin_receiver.title: Which Okin receiver is it?
okin_receiver.description: Choose the bed or remote the receiver came with. If none matches, choose **None of these**.

settings.title: Adjustable Bed Options
settings.description: Adjust the settings for your adjustable bed. To change the bed type or app, open **Reconfigure** from this entry's three-dot menu.

data.baseremote_single_base: One base, not separate left and right sides
data.vibradorm_restored: Match settings saved in the Caresse app
data.motion_bed_restored: Use a profile restored by the app
data.richmat_classic_third_service: Bed without the app's usual connection

data_description.motor_count: How many motors the bed has. If the app has 2M, 3M and 4M screens, choose the screen you use.
data_description.malouf_layout: Choose the controls on the bed's remote. The bed does not report them itself.
data_description.malouf_memory_slots: Choose the number of memory buttons on the physical remote. Automatic uses one for the two-motor layout and two otherwise.
data_description.passive_position_reconciliation: Now and then reconnect while idle and read the position, so Home Assistant catches up with moves made with the remote. On by default for Linak beds. It briefly uses the Bluetooth connection.
data_description.preferred_adapter: Select a specific Bluetooth adapter or proxy, or let Home Assistant choose automatically.
data_description.cb24_bed_selection: Which side of a split bed this entry controls. Both moves both sides.
data_description.protocol_variant: The remote code, the model or layout the app shows, or the side this entry controls. Keep Automatic if you are not sure.
data_description.richmat_remote: The code on your Richmat remote. It is filled in when the bed name carries it; keep Automatic if you are not sure.
data_description.rmcontrol_product: The product code RMControl shows for this bed. Choose None to use the Richmat remote controls instead.
data_description.rmcontrol_side: The side selected in RMControl. It picks the side the app's commands address, not a paired bed's left or right in Home Assistant.
data_description.baseremote_single_base: Turn on when the app's Left and Right tabs move the same base. Each control then appears once.
data_description.motor_pulse_count: How many times a tap repeats its command. Higher numbers move further per tap.
data_description.idle_disconnect_seconds: How long the link stays open after the last command, from 1 to 300 seconds.
data_description.octo_pin: Enter the four-digit PIN, or leave empty if the bed does not require one.
data_description.jensen_pin: PIN code for Jensen bed authentication. Default PIN is 3060. Leave it empty to use the default.
data_description.pairlink_role: **Connect to this bed** keeps Home Assistant connected to this bed. **Join the Pairlink network from this host** makes a Bluetooth adapter on this Home Assistant host join the bed's Pairlink network itself.
data_description.pairlink_host_source: The Bluetooth adapter on this Home Assistant host that joins the Pairlink network. Needed only for **Join the Pairlink network from this host**; a Bluetooth proxy cannot do this. A saved adapter that is not active now stays in the list.
data_description.pairlink_home_id: Leave blank to use the home ID the bed advertises, or 5566 if it advertises none. Otherwise enter the home ID as a whole number.
data_description.pairlink_password_text: The Pairlink network password, exactly four characters. The default is 1122.
data_description.pairlink_password_hex: Only if the password has characters you cannot type: enter it as eight hex digits. It applies only while the password above is 1122.
data_description.back_max_angle: Maximum angle for back/head motors. Adjust if position readings don't match your bed's actual range.
data_description.legs_max_angle: Maximum angle for legs/feet motors. Adjust if position readings don't match your bed's actual range.
data_description.leggett_app_profile: Choose the app you use with this bed. It sets the motors and controls.
data_description.logicdata_app_profile: The app you use with this bed.
data_description.logicdata_app_family: The P1 or P2 setting in the app.
data_description.logicdata_app_layout: The layout set in the app. Sleep Smart beds use the two-motor standard or split-series layout.
data_description.logicdata_app_transport: Automatic finds the bed's connection. Change it only if the bed has more than one.
data_description.has_light: Show the light controls when this bed has under-bed lighting.
data_description.jiecang_app_profile: The app you use with this bed.
data_description.jiecang_app_layout: The layout set in the app.
data_description.jiecang_app_transport: Automatic finds the bed's connection. Change it only if setup can't reach the bed.
data_description.lp_legacy_model: The four-character model code the L&P Adjustable Base app shows.
data_description.lp_legacy_mode: The app does not show this, and the remote code does not tell. It comes from a capture of the app working with this bed; without one, ask in a support request before you guess.
data_description.lp_legacy_write_uuid: The app does not show this. Connect to the bed in a Bluetooth scanner app such as nRF Connect, find the characteristic whose properties include Write or Write Without Response, and copy its full ID.
data_description.lp_legacy_read_uuid: Optional. The full ID of the characteristic the bed answers on, from the same scanner app. Leave empty if you are not sure.
data_description.malouf_app_profile: The app you use with this bed.
data_description.malouf_app_model: Choose the model the app shows for this bed.
data_description.malouf_app_transport: Automatic follows the bed's name. Change it only if setup can't reach the bed.
data_description.malouf_app_primary: Match the physical primary/secondary setting in the app. Home Assistant Left/Right labels do not change this role.
data_description.vibradorm_app_profile: The app you use with this bed.
data_description.vibradorm_restored: Turn on only if you set the bed up earlier in the Caresse app and want the same controls here.
data_description.vibradorm_control_type: The control layout your app shows.
data_description.vibradorm_floor_default: The floor light level your app remembers, from 1 to 8.
data_description.vibradorm_vmat_remote: The remote VMAT shows for this bed.
data_description.vmatbasic_floor_level: Optional. CBI accepts 0 to 255; XT-Box accepts 1 to 6.
data_description.vmatbasic_floor_minutes: CBI accepts 0 to 1439 minutes; XT-Box accepts 0 to 255.
data_description.vmatbasic_profile: The product the V-MAT Basic app shows.
data_description.motion_bed_preset: Automatic follows the bed's name. Change it only if the presets are wrong.
data_description.ble_device_name: The bed's Bluetooth name exactly as the app shows it, including capital letters.
data_description.motion_bed_restored: Turn on only if the app restored this profile from a backup.
data_description.motion_bed_movement: Automatic follows the bed's name. Change it only if the movement buttons are wrong.
data_description.starcode_lift_entries: Lifts this bed controls, from the beds already set up here: up to three AdjustableM5X5 or DewertOkin ELEVATE lifts when this bed runs the AdjustableM5X5 app, or up to two ELEVATE lifts set to Adjustable Comfort M1X12 when it runs that app. Each lift keeps its own Bluetooth address and controls.
data_description.starcode_m5x5_profile: The bed class that matches the start of the bed's Bluetooth name. ELEVATE lifts are set up as DewertOkin Elevate lift (two motors).
data_description.sleeptracker_unit_number: Leave at 0 unless the bed has more than one processor. Then use the number the app shows for this one.
data_description.sleeptracker_snapshot_side: The part of the bed this processor reports on. Leave at Left side for a single bed.
data_description.sleeptracker_processor_type: Leave at 0. Change it only if the app cannot save presets on this bed: types 5, 6 and 7 turn preset saving off here too.
data_description.sleepys_elite_selector: The control box the MFRM Sleepy's Elite app shows for this bed. Choose none if it names none.
data_description.richmat_classic_third_service: Turn on only if the bed offers none of the app's usual Bluetooth services. The app then uses another one it finds.
data_description.octo_motor_count_override: Automatic uses the number of motors the bed reports.
data_description.starcode_m1x12_profile: The profile that matches the bed's Bluetooth name.
data_description.comfort_enhancement3_remote_code: Use the printed code exactly, including capitalization. No spaces are added or removed.
data_description.read_positions: Show the bed's position and allow moving to a set position. Turn off if reading the position stops the physical remote from working.
data_description.connection_mode: How long Home Assistant keeps the Bluetooth link after a command. Most beds accept one connection at a time, so releasing it lets the remote and the bed's app connect again.
data_description.agingplace_bed_mode: With two sensors, only the sensor side is shown; the other modes show every reading. Automatic shows every reading until the bed reports how many sensors it has, so choose Two sensors when you know it has two.
data_description.agingplace_bed_side: The side whose occupancy, heart rate and breathing rate are shown when the bed has two sensors. It does not change which side the controls move.
data_description.agingplace_selected_side: The sensor side shown when Selectable side is chosen. This setting belongs to this physical bed.
data_description.fsm_relax_memory_names: One name per memory, M1 to M8. Leave a name empty to use its default name.
data_description.furnimove_remote: The handset ID printed on your remote or shown in the FurniMove / OKIN Smart Remote app.
data_description.starcode_abm5_4_command_selector: Automatic works for most beds. Choose the control box type only if the bed responds wrongly.
data_description.starcode_abm5_4_transport_selector: Automatic follows the bed's Bluetooth name. Change it only if the bed doesn't respond.
data_description.product_type: The product, model or layout the app shows for this bed.
data_description.sleeptracker_restricted: Leave off. Turn on only if the app connects to this processor without signing in.
data_description.kaidi_sofa_acu_no: Filled in from the bed. Change it only if the side controls are wrong.
data_description.kaidi_room_id: A bed that is already set up keeps its room number, so keep the number shown. For a new bed, choose its room, then use the enrollment action after setup.
data_description.gmmotor_side: The side GM Control drives with this product. The product must offer that side.
data_description.ergomotion4_model_keys: The remote and preset buttons your product has, in the order the app lists them.
data_description.ergomotion4_massage_keys: The extra motors and massage your product has. Leave a feature off if the app does not show it.
data_description.ergomotion4_product_name: The product name exactly as the app shows it.
data_description.serta_mp_memory_1_head: Only if you changed memory 1 in the app: its head angle, in degrees.
data_description.serta_mp_memory_1_foot: Only if you changed memory 1 in the app: its foot angle, in degrees.
data_description.serta_mp_memory_2_head: Only if you changed memory 2 in the app: its head angle, in degrees.
data_description.serta_mp_memory_2_foot: Only if you changed memory 2 in the app: its foot angle, in degrees.
data_description.serta_mp_memory_3_head: Only if you changed memory 3 in the app: its head angle, in degrees.
data_description.serta_mp_memory_3_foot: Only if you changed memory 3 in the app: its foot angle, in degrees.
data_description.serta_mp_memory_4_head: Only if you changed memory 4 in the app: its head angle, in degrees.
data_description.serta_mp_memory_4_foot: Only if you changed memory 4 in the app: its foot angle, in degrees.
data_description.symphony_side: For a standalone ES500 split-head product, choose the side this entry operates. Paired child controls use their own Left/Right target.
data_description.sleep_assistant_presets: Select the presets shown for this bed, in their displayed order.
data_description.sleep_assistant_controls: Select only the controls shown for this bed.
data_description.sleep_assistant_lighting: Choose the lighting model selected in Sleep Assist.
data_description.sleep_assistant_identity: Eight decimal digits from the selected bed identity. Leave empty if unknown.
data_description.sleep_assistant_parameters: Optional local JSON with calibration, gain, out_of_bed, anti_snore and anti_snore_levels values from your selected model. Leave empty if unknown. No account or login data.

remove_bond.title: Remove the Bluetooth bond
remove_bond.description:
This removes the Bluetooth bond that **{name}** ({address}) has with this Home Assistant host.

**Bond stored on:** {transport}{provenance}

Home Assistant will disconnect from the bed first. Afterwards the bed will need pairing again before it can be controlled, and you may need to put it back into pairing mode to do that.

This does **not** delete the Adjustable Bed device or its settings. Select **Submit** to remove the bond, or close this dialog to leave it alone.

estimate_flat.title: Calibrate {motor}
estimate_flat.description:
Step {step} of {steps}, {motor}.

The {motor} must be fully lowered before it is measured. Lower it with the card or the remote, or let this step lower it. Only you can confirm that it is fully lowered.

menu_options.estimate_flat_confirm: It is fully lowered, raise it now

estimate_lowering.title: Lowering {motor}
estimate_lowering.description: The {motor} is moving down. Select **It is fully lowered now** once it has stopped moving. Movement stops by itself after {max_s} s.

estimate_raise.title: Calibrate {motor}
estimate_raise.description:
Step {step} of {steps}, {motor}.

The {motor} is moving up from fully lowered. Select **Reached the top** the moment it stops moving.

The time runs from the first movement command. Movement stops by itself after {max_s} s if you do nothing. Tapping adds a small delay; you can fine tune the times on the last step.

menu_options.estimate_cancel: Stop, something is wrong. Nothing is saved

estimate_lower.title: Calibrate {motor}
estimate_lower.description:
Step {step} of {steps}, {motor}.

The {motor} is moving down. Select **Reached the bottom** the moment it stops moving. Movement stops by itself after {max_s} s if you do nothing.

estimate_retry.title: {motor} was not measured
estimate_retry.description: The movement was not timed. It may not have started yet, it may have reached the {max_s} s safety stop first, or it failed. The {motor} has been stopped.

estimate_review.title: Review calibration
estimate_review.description:
Step {step} of {steps}.

The seconds each motor takes for its full travel. Adjust them to fine tune, or type them if you timed the bed with a stopwatch. Motors you just measured ended fully lowered, so their reference is set and they start at 0%. Times can be measured again any time from this menu; changing them keeps your saved positions.

confirm.title: Pair your adjustable bed
confirm.description:
**{name}** ({address}) needs a Bluetooth bond before it can be controlled.

1. Put the bed into pairing mode. Most OKIN bases (Okimat, Rize, Jordan's, Nectar, Mattress Firm 900-O): unplug the control box for 30 seconds, then plug it back in. Leggett & Platt Smart Bed: unplug the bed and take the batteries out of the power supply, then plug it back in and wait for the chime and the pulsing blue light. Other beds: hold the pairing button on the control box or remote until its light blinks.
2. While the bed is in pairing mode, select **Submit**.
3. If pairing keeps failing, remove the old pairing and try again. On a Home Assistant host, run `bluetoothctl remove {address}`. Through an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, the pairing is stored on the proxy, so clear it there. One common cause is an old pairing that no longer matches.

Pairing happens on Home Assistant or its Bluetooth proxy, not on your phone. ESPHome proxies need ESPHome 2024.3.0 or newer.

proxy_pairing.title: Pair your bed through the Bluetooth proxy
proxy_pairing.description:
**{name}** ({address}) connected through Bluetooth proxy **{transport}**, but authentication failed. The bed may need pairing, or saved pairing keys may no longer match.

1. Close the bed's phone app and keep the proxy near the bed.
2. Put the bed into **Bluetooth pairing mode**, following its manufacturer's instructions. For Sleep Number Climate 360 / FlexFit Fuzion, hold the side pairing button until the blue light blinks.
3. Select **Submit** to try pairing again through the bed's configured Bluetooth path. Keep using the same proxy.

If the **same authentication error** returns, follow the [step-by-step proxy recovery guide]({recovery_url}). It explains how to save your proxy configuration, connect it by USB, fully erase its flash, reinstall its original configuration, and pair again. A normal wireless firmware update does **not** erase saved pairing keys.

**A full erase is a last resort:** it removes the proxy's Wi-Fi settings and **all Bluetooth pairings**, including other devices. This repair does not erase anything automatically. Timeouts or missing Bluetooth services alone are not a reason to erase the proxy.

stale_bond_confirm.title: Replace a bond the bed no longer accepts
stale_bond_confirm.description:
**{name}** ({address}) connects, but every encrypted read is refused. That is what happens when this host still holds a Bluetooth bond the bed itself has forgotten, usually after the bed was reset or paired with something else.

**Bond stored on:** {transport}

Continuing removes that bond and creates a new one. Home Assistant checks the bed is reachable before removing anything, so a sleeping bed will not be left without a bond, and the new bond is only recorded once it has been confirmed to work.

Put the bed into pairing mode, then select **Submit**.

abort.pairing_failed: Pairing didn't finish. Put the bed back into pairing mode, check that it is in range of your Bluetooth adapter or proxy, then run this repair again. If it keeps failing, remove the old pairing on the adapter or proxy and try again.
abort.proxy_pairing_requires_setup:
This bed accepts only one connection while pairing.

1. In the bed's options, set **{transport}** as its Bluetooth adapter.
2. Put the bed into pairing mode.
3. Reload the bed's entry.

If pairing through that proxy still fails, follow the [proxy recovery guide]({recovery_url}).
abort.proxy_pairing_issue_changed: The pairing issue changed while this repair was open. Open the current repair to retry through the proxy that most recently failed.
abort.stale_bond_recovery_failed: The bond could not be recovered, so this repair stays open. Put the bed into pairing mode and run it again.
abort.recovery_success: ✅ The Bluetooth bond was confirmed. The bed should respond normally now.
abort.recovery_not_advertising: ❌ The bed is not advertising, so nothing was changed and the old bond is still in place. Put the bed into pairing mode and run this repair again.
abort.recovery_unpair_failed: ❌ The old bond could not be removed, so nothing else was attempted.
abort.recovery_unpair_unconfirmed: ❌ Removing the old bond could not be confirmed, so it may or may not still be there and no new one was made. Put the bed into pairing mode and run this repair again.
abort.recovery_failed_unchanged: ❌ The existing bond could not be checked safely, so nothing was changed. Make sure the bed is in range and run this repair again.
abort.recovery_partial: ❌ The old bond was removed but the new one could not be confirmed, so this repair stays open. Put the bed into pairing mode and run it again.

error.pairing_failed: Pairing did not complete. Check that the bed is still in pairing mode and the same proxy is online, then retry. Use the recovery guide below only if authentication keeps failing.
error.pairing_not_supported: This proxy cannot pair through its current Bluetooth backend. Update its ESPHome firmware to 2024.3.0 or newer, then retry. Do not erase the proxy's flash for this error.
error.pairing_route_mismatch: Home Assistant retried through a different or unknown Bluetooth path. This does not confirm a failure on the named proxy. Check which proxy is connected and retry before using the recovery guide; do not erase that proxy based on this retry.
